name: Ranger Elven Enchantments: Searing Quiver damage grants Elven Enchantments stacks (#2497)
contract: Elven Enchantments 705054 reads 'dealing damage with Searing or Poison Quiver now grants a stack of Elven Enchantments ... stacking 10 times.' Its only firing effect is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL on 560698; Spell.dbc ProcFlags is 0; the spell_proc row from rev_20260921_40_ranger_dead_procs.sql supplies ProcFlags 262400 = DONE_SPELL_RANGED_DMG_CLASS (0x100, the Fire Arrows 681109 hit) plus DONE_PERIODIC (0x40000, the Poison Quiver 500104 ticks), SpellFamilyName 27 with mask (0,525312,0) = 524288 Fire Arrows | 1024 Poison Quiver, SchoolMask 12 (Fire|Nature), phase HIT and AttributesMask 2 so the triggered Fire Arrows can proc. 560698 is a 10-stack cumulative self aura. Expected: with Searing Quiver up but without the talent, Fire Arrows damage grants no 560698; once 705054 is learned, each Fire Arrows hit grants one 560698 stack. The +25% quiver damage halves of the tooltip ride 705054's own effects 1-2 natively and are not asserted here.
